(koci)madhvarāyācārya
(1857-1931) son of Cochi Raṅgappācārya, adorned the court of Cochin, after his father's death. He has written many tracts an. kroḍapatras an. published a fr. of the Candrikābhūṣaṇa.
-C. on the Nayamālikā.
Ref. “The Modern Period in Dvaita Literature” in the Quarterly Journal of the Mythic Society, XXIX, p. 448.
See BNK. Sharma, His.. of Dvai. Lit. Vol. II. p. 357.
